description: This file contains functions related to booking and event type retrieval, handling seat-based bookings, and fetching recurring bookings, utilizing Prisma ORM and external schemas.

methods.name: getEventTypesFromDB
methods.description: Fetches detailed event type data from the database, including related profile, team, workflows, and metadata, and processes metadata and booking fields.

methods.name: handleSeatsEventTypeOnBooking
methods.description: Handles seat-specific logic during booking, including fetching seat attendee info, updating booking responses, and filtering attendees based on seat info and user role.

methods.name: getRecurringBookings
methods.description: Retrieves start times of recurring bookings associated with a given recurring event ID, filtering by accepted or pending status.
